title: Paul McCartney performs on Saturday Night Live 40th anniversary special
content:
Paul McCartney was among the celebrity guests appearing on the 40th anniversary special of Saturday Night Live.

The former Beatle performed an impromptu acoustic duet with Paul Simon of ‘I’ve Just Seen A Face’ with a performance of ‘Maybe I’m Amazed’. The performance was introduced by Keith Richards:

In the early Sixties a band came out of England and it changed the world But enough about the Rolling Stones: Ladies and gentlemen, Paul McCartney.
Keith Richards
The Rolling Stones

Amazing rehearsal for #SNL40 today! photo by@mjkim_lalala pic.twitter.com/OaUULE5OtC

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) February 15, 2015

The three-hour SNL40 special was recorded at NBC Studios in Manhattan, New York City. The night before, McCartney had performed a surprise show for 1,000 people at Irving Plaza.

SNL40 was kicked off by Jimmy Fallon and Justin Timberlake. Other guests included Steve Martin, Tom Hanks, Justin Timberlake, Jack Nicholson, Tom Hanks, Chris Rock, Billy Crystal, Bradley Cooper, Taylor Swift, Eddie Murphy, and SNL creator Lorne Michaels. Other musical performances were by Paul Simon, Miley Cyrus and Kanye West.

Thank you #SNL40! Here's to 40 more! Photo by @MJKIM_lalala pic.twitter.com/S4IPuIuRLa

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) February 16, 2015

Page last updated: 16 February 2015
